title: Venezuelan Chicken Empanadas
description: Crunchy empanadas filled with spicy chicken and baked to perfection, perfect for a romantic dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned
Add the red pepper flakes and cook for 1 minute
In a large bowl, combine the cooked chicken mixture and beaten egg
Roll out the empanada dough and cut into circles
Place a spoonful of the chicken mixture onto the center of each circle
Fold the dough in half and press the edges to seal
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
